subject: Hospitality
title: Indian Weddings: Multi-Day Spectacles
description: A fast breakdown of Indian Weddings: Multi-Day Spectacles for builders.

hook.text: Indian weddings last 3–7 days with multiple ceremonies, hundreds of guests, and budgets that rival corporate events.

buildup.text: Events include mehndi, sangeet, baraat, ceremony, and reception—each requiring different décor, catering, music, and logistics.

discovery.text: India's wedding industry is worth $50+ billion annually. Five-star hotels compete fiercely for wedding season (October–February).

twist.text: Indian families often book entire hotels—200–500 rooms for 3+ nights. A single wedding can generate $1M+ in total hotel revenue.

climax.text: Hotels assign dedicated wedding teams 6–12 months in advance. The complexity demands project management at corporate event scale.

punchline.text: Seven days, 500 guests, $1M revenue. Indian weddings are the ultimate test.

quiz.question: How much is India's wedding industry worth annually?
